_comment: Surviving bin/break-mutants.mjs mutants that are equivalent by construction (or UNREACHABLE, not equivalent). Key: <file>#<fingerprint of the loop and the statement after it>:<kind>[@<break index>]. The fingerprint ignores comments and whitespace, so an entry survives unrelated edits and goes stale exactly when the code it is about changes; `--check` then fails on it (ticket 0045).

lib/lapack/base/dlaed2/lib/base.js#d01ba: The break is taken inside the body of `while ( k2 + i <= N )` with k2 and i unmodified since the loop test, so the guard `k2 + i > N` is false whenever the loop breaks.

The guard is the negation of the while condition, so it is true on normal exit; on a break the unguarded body repeats the store INDXP(k2+i-1) = pj that the else-branch made immediately before the break, a no-op.
lib/lapack/base/dlasq2/lib/base.js#02109: The break is inside `for ( i4 = 4*n0; i4 >= 8; i4 -= 4 )` with i4 unmodified in the body, so i4 >= 8 at every break and the guard `i4 < 8` is false.

lib/lapack/base/dlasq2/lib/base.js#d8d48: UNREACHABLE (not equivalent): the mutant drops the final Z repacking on the INFO = 2 (iteration limit) path. About 300k fuzzed inputs through the public API (n = 2..27, NaN/Inf/subnormal/extreme/graded) never reached it: dlasq3 deflates NaN immediately and finite inputs converge well within 100*n iterations. Reaching it would need dlasq3 mocked.
